name: MUNU
summary: MUNU measured low-energy reactor-antineutrino electron scattering at Bugey with a tracking gas detector. Reconstructing the recoil-electron direction allowed a forward signal region and background control regions to be compared.
detection_principle: A carbon-tetrafluoride gas time projection chamber reconstructs electron tracks and ionization energy. A surrounding scintillator anti-Compton veto suppresses external gamma backgrounds; forward/backward angular information constrains magnetic scattering.

key_parameters.name: Magnetic-moment bound
key_parameters.value: Less than 9 × 10^-11 Bohr magnetons at 90% confidence

results.summary: The final analysis set a magnetic-moment upper limit and demonstrated reconstruction of electron tracks down to 150 keV at 1 bar.
